P1.finding: The primary compact path prices two 3000x48-bit assignment banks but does not freeze a field-by-field 48-bit descriptor layout. Original-order replay plausibly fits, yet destination/original mask/global center/use-PWP/distance-or-recompute/valid and fallback semantics must be exact before the event model can claim this capacity.
P1.required_closure: The future M461 contract must freeze all bit fields, invalid/sentinel semantics, center-to-slot lookup timing and 48-to-64-bit macro-padding sensitivity before opening the ordered ledger.

P2.finding: The all-128 structural p95 field is labeled nearest-rank/index-floor but 1576 equals sorted[floor(0.95*(n-1))]; standard nearest-rank is 1584.
P2.required_closure: Pick and name one percentile convention in the future contract; do not silently compare 1576 and 1584.

P2.finding: B's per-tile 27552-B compatibility footprint includes 288 B config in each tile and doubles to 55104 B, while its integrated two-phase lower bound uses only two shared 288-B config banks (576 B total). The arithmetic can be valid only if the future architecture explicitly distinguishes duplicated slot-address footprint from physically shared config storage.
P2.required_closure: Label per-tile compatibility footprint and integrated physical/shared storage separately in the next table.

score.deduction: 3 points for the future-contract-critical 48-bit layout gap and 1 point for each non-admission clarity/statistics issue.

review_conclusion: GO is limited to writing and running a future exact-SHA M461 contract/event model after M453b passes its frozen gate and independent hammer. The prereview is structurally and arithmetically sound enough for that next step, but it authorizes neither RTL nor any performance number.
